name: Lead Capture
job: Enroll new next-lander contacts, create one Sales opportunity, stamp location and current clinic, and hand off to the non-booked burst.

trigger.notes: No source filter on the trigger. WordPress handoff runs /api/handoff/wordpress then /api/qualify upsert; source wordpress-form is an inner branch only, never a trigger filter.

named_steps.name: TRIGGER: Contact Created (tag next-lander only)
named_steps.comment: Sole enroll. Must not add a source filter. Must not rename next-lander.

named_steps.name: IF-ELSE: Guard against duplicate Sales opp (create-once)
named_steps.comment: Native check for an existing open opp in Sales Lead to Close before create. Must not move stages.

named_steps.name: CREATE-OPP: New Lead in Sales Lead to Close (create-once)
named_steps.comment: Pipeline Vt8cPz51C3i87moo73gQ, stage New Lead. Allow Duplicate is ON but this branch only fires when no open opp exists. Must not set monetaryValue.

named_steps.name: SET-FIELD: Stamp location_* (from mapped source)
named_steps.comment: Writes location_* fields for the contact. Must not rename existing live location_* tags.

named_steps.name: SET-FIELD: Stamp current_clinic_* Method 2 (WF-01 only)
named_steps.comment: Sole writer of current_clinic_slug and current_clinic_* fields. Slugs limited to richmond, virginia-beach, newport-news.

named_steps.name: IF-ELSE: Branch on source wordpress-form (inner branch only)
named_steps.comment: Inner branch to route WP-origin contacts. Must not create a Sales opp here; qualify already upserted the contact via /api/qualify.

named_steps.name: ADD-TAG: v2_source_wp (inner wordpress-form branch)
named_steps.comment: New v2 tag only. Must not touch legacy source tags.

named_steps.name: EMAIL: Welcome (native template)
named_steps.comment: Sends EML | WF-01 | Welcome. Copy uses members not patients, clinic not office, no-cost not free, no em-dashes, no guy.

named_steps.name: SMS: Welcome with STOP opt-out (first SMS)
named_steps.comment: Inline body. First SMS to any contact carries STOP opt-out. Honors quiet hours 8am-9pm contact TZ.

named_steps.name: ADD-TAG: v2_enrolled_wf01 (audit)
named_steps.comment: Audit tag for WF-01 enroll. Must not rename next-lander.

named_steps.name: WAIT: 24 hours (quiet-hours aware)
named_steps.comment: Native wait step. Must not skip quiet hours.

named_steps.name: ADD-TO-WF: Route to WF-02 Non-booked
named_steps.comment: Hand-off to non-booked burst. Must not filter by funnel_entry_* here; WF-02 enforces the exclusion.
